headline: Rays Punch Their Ticket
caption:
The Tampa Bay Rays are your AL champions, closing out the Cleveland Guardians 4-2 in the ALCS.

Our model had the Rays before the series started, but not by much: a 56% pick, which means Cleveland had a very real shot. It projected a 4-3 series; the Rays finished it a game early. A close call that landed on the right side.

That makes our pre-series picks 7 of 9 correct this postseason. Every one of them was posted before the first pitch, hits and misses alike.

Did you see the Rays winning this one, or were you riding with Cleveland?
reason: All the stats check out: the 4-2 result, the 56% pick, the 4-3 projection ending a game early, and the 7 of 9 record; the only soft spot is that 'every one posted before the first pitch' is a process claim the facts don't directly confirm, and the play is already decided so there is no loser framing.

The fallers tell their own story. The Dodgers climbed as high as 37% before dropping to zero. Cleveland peaked at 20%, the Yankees at 17%, and the White Sox at 9%, all now eliminated. A one-in-three shot is far from nothing, so the Rays are very much alive.

reason: Calling Tampa Bay 'the biggest riser on the chart' misreads the facts: Milwaukee rose 41 points (26% to 67%) versus the Rays' 23 (10% to 33%), and the Rays' 22-point jump was only the biggest move today.
